remarks: Beautiful City Colonial Near Delaware Park & Museum District. Welcome to this charming city colonial, perfectly situated just a short walk from the arts, science, and history museums, with Delaware Park practically at your doorstep. Enjoy the best of urban living with effortless access to cultural attractions, green space, and everything this vibrant neighborhood has to offer. Step inside to find a large living room featuring two sets of double French doors that open onto a spacious front covered porch—ideal for relaxing or entertaining. Hardwood flooring extends through many rooms, adding warmth and classic character throughout the home. A first-floor den/family room with built-in bookcases provides the perfect spot for reading, working, or gathering. The updated kitchen is a true highlight, outfitted with a Wolf gas stove, LG dishwasher and refrigerator, solid-surface countertops, and refreshed cabinetry—ready for everyday meals or serious cooking. Additional features include a finished walk-up third floor for flexible living space, a high-efficiency Lennox furnace with central air conditioning for year-round comfort, and a maintenance-free rear wood deck for outdoor enjoyment. This well-cared-for colonial blends timeless style with modern conveniences in one of the city’s most desirable locations. Don’t miss the opportunity to call it home. Offers due by Wednesday, October 21st, 2026 at 5:00PM. No escalation clauses.
